permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: home-latest-update
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update-youtube-latest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

changes.before:
with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Fetch latest YouTube data
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID || 'UCdnf6zMzSdZuvUxS-CS2REQ' }}
          YOUTUBE_HANDLE: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_HANDLE || '@えりぬい' }}
          YOUTUBE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
        run: node scripts/update-youtube-latest.mjs

      - name: Fetch latest note articles
        env:
          NOTE_RSS_URL: "https://note.com/erinui/rss"
          NOTE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
        run: node scripts/update-note-latest.mjs

      - name: Fetch latest SUZURI products
        env:
          SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SUZURI_USER_NAME: "erikanuinui"
          SUZURI_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
        run: |
          if [ -z "$SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN is not configured. Keeping the current data."
            exit 0
          fi
          node scripts/update-suzuri-latest.mjs

      - name: Commit updated home data
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet -- assets/home-city; then
            echo "No home data updates."
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A -- assets/home-city
          git commit -m "Update home latest data"
          git push origin HEAD:main
changes.after:
with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Collect and validate isolated updates
        id: collect
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID || 'UCdnf6zMzSdZuvUxS-CS2REQ' }}
          YOUTUBE_HANDLE: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_HANDLE || '@えりぬい' }}
          YOUTUBE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
          NOTE_RSS_URL: "https://note.com/erinui/rss"
          NOTE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
          SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SUZURI_USER_NAME: "erikanuinui"
          SUZURI_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json"

      - name: Save validated home data
        id: save
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --publish --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json"

      - name: Report final retrieval and save status
        if: always()
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --finish --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json" --saved "${{ steps.save.outcome }}"
